questions.text: Jika f(x) = 2x² - 4x + 5, tentukan koordinat titik puncak parabola fungsi kuadrat tersebut!
questions.explanation: Sumbu simetri x = -b/(2a) = -(-4)/(2*2) = 1. f(1) = 2(1) - 4(1) + 5 = 3. Jadi titik puncak (1, 3).
